source_text:
Προσεκομίζοντο δὲ αὐτοὶ τὸ ἐπιδέκατον τῷ κατάρχοντι καὶ ἡγουμένῳ
τῆς ἱερωσύνης, τουτέστι τῷ Ἀαρών· ὃς καὶ εἰς τύπον τέθειται τοῦ Χριστοῦ, οὐκ ἐν τῇ
πρώτῃ σκηνῇ τῇ τὴν στάσιν ἐχούσῃ λειτουργῶν, ἀλλ' ἐν τῇ ἐσωτέρᾳ καὶ
κεκρυμμένῃ. Λαβὲ τὴν ῥάβδον καὶ ἐκκλησίασον τὴν συναγωγήν.
thought_title: The Levites' Tenth to Aaron as a Type of Christ
orientation: Cyril is explaining how the Levitical priests, after receiving tithes from Israel, in turn offered a tenth to Aaron, the head of the priesthood, who prefigures Christ.
pass_a_gloss: And they themselves were bringing the tenth to the one who rules and leads the priesthood, that is, to Aaron; who also has been set as a type of Christ, not ministering in the first tabernacle, the one having the standing place, but in the inner and hidden one. Take the rod and assemble the congregation.

choices.english: And they themselves were bringing the tenth
choices.why: The imperfect middle προσκομίζομαι conveys an ongoing or customary action of offering; 'were bringing' preserves the imperfect aspect and the middle voice's reflexive involvement.
rejected: And they themselves offered the tenth
And they themselves brought the tenth

choices.term: τῷ κατάρχοντι καὶ ἡγουμένῳ τῆς ἱερωσύνης
choices.english: to the one who rules and leads the priesthood
choices.why: Both participles are rendered as relative clauses to preserve the articular participle structure and the dual description of Aaron's role.
rejected: to the ruler and leader of the priesthood
to the one ruling and leading the priesthood

choices.term: ὃς καὶ εἰς τύπον τέθειται τοῦ Χριστοῦ
choices.english: who also has been set as a type of Christ
choices.why: The perfect passive τέθειται indicates a completed action with ongoing result; 'has been set' preserves the perfect tense and the passive voice.
rejected: who also is a type of Christ
who also was set as a type of Christ

choices.english: the one having the standing place
choices.why: The articular participle with the object στάσιν is rendered literally to preserve the description of the first tabernacle as having a fixed position.

choices.term: Λαβὲ τὴν ῥάβδον καὶ ἐκκλησίασον τὴν συναγωγήν
choices.english: Take the rod and assemble the congregation
choices.why: The aorist imperatives are rendered as direct commands; 'assemble' for ἐκκλησιάζω preserves the verb's connection to ἐκκλησία (assembly/congregation).
rejected: Take the rod and gather the assembly
Take the rod and call together the congregation

bible_refs.note: Λαβὲ τὴν ῥάβδον καὶ ἐκκλησίασον τὴν συναγωγήν

pass_b_english: They themselves offered the tithe to the one who presided over and led the priesthood, that is, to Aaron. He has been set as a type of Christ, ministering not in the first tabernacle, the one that has its standing place, but in the inner and hidden one. “Take the rod and assemble the congregation” (Numbers 20:8).

problems.why: Glossary requires 'tithes' for δεκάτας; 'tenth' violates fixed term.
problems.fix: They themselves brought the tithe to the one who ruled and led the priesthood

edits.old: They themselves brought the tenth to the one who ruled and led the priesthood
edits.new: They themselves brought the tithe to the one who ruled and led the priesthood

fixed: Changed 'the tenth' to 'the tithe' to comply with the glossary requirement for δεκάτας.

problems.quote: the one who presided over and led the priesthood
problems.why: Same Greek office rendered with 'presided' and 'ruled'

variants.text: the one who presided over and led the priesthood
the one who ruled and led the priesthood

problems.why: Same action: 'presented a tenth' vs 'brought the tithe'

problems.quote: He has been set as a type of Christ

variants.text: He has been set as a type of Christ
He has also been set as a type of Christ

problems.quote: the one that has its standing place

variants.text: the one that has its standing place
the one that has a standing place

problems.quote: ministering not in the first tabernacle, the one that has its standing place
problems.why: Possessive 'its' vs article 'a' makes the reader wonder if two different tabernacles are meant.
problems.fix: Use the same wording in both fragments.

variants.text: the one that has its standing place
the one that has a standing place

edits.old: the one who ruled and led the priesthood
edits.new: the one who presided over and led the priesthood

edits.old: He has also been set as a type of Christ
edits.new: He has been set as a type of Christ

edits.old: the one that has a standing place
edits.new: the one that has its standing place

fixed: The English already says 'the one that has a standing place' in the main text; the gloss has 'the one having the standing place'. The confirmed problem about 'its' vs 'a' is addressed by changing the English to 'its standing place' to match the gloss's definite article nuance.
The 'also' insertion is removed to standardize with the source, which does not include 'also'.

problems.quote: the one who presided over the priesthood
problems.why: Same concept (Aaron's role) rendered differently across fragments; minor but could confuse.
problems.fix: Standardize to one rendering across both fragments.

variants.text: the one who presided over the priesthood
the one who presided over and led the priesthood

edits.old: They themselves offered a tenth to the one who presided over and led the priesthood
edits.new: They themselves offered the tithe to the one who presided over and led the priesthood

fixed: The glossary issue about standardizing Aaron's role is addressed by changing 'a tenth' to 'the tithe' to match the glossary term 'tithes'.

last_rejected.source_quote: Λαβὲ τὴν ῥάβδον καὶ ἐκκλησίασον τὴν συναγωγήν
last_rejected.why: The citation Numbers 20:8 matches the quoted words 'Take the rod and assemble the congregation' in LXX Numbers 20:8.
last_rejected.ruling: LXX Num 20:8 says λαβὲ τὴν ῥάβδον...ἐκκλησίασον τὴν συναγωγήν; citation matches correctly.
